about: The ONLY query params the game may read (wildshard/no-url-switch, lint/wildshard-plugin.js). Jake, 2026-09-25: no URL switches, ever; every variant goes in pause > Settings > Debug. harness = what the test / capture / bench scripts and the app's own reload plumbing pass; adding to it needs Jake's explicit OK. legacy = old variant switches, grandfathered only until they move to the debug menu (see the migration ask); never add to it, only remove. readers = helper functions whose argument is a param name (name -> argument index); their calls are checked like reads.
